Give views the tracker the way each framework passes values down, and let modifiers and controls track what views do.

Keep each record on disk until it is delivered, so a record the app tracked survives the process ending.
Vendor-neutral analytics for Swift: typed events, tracked by a tracker and delivered in batches to any number of destinations.
Export the JSON Schema of every event an app tracks, commit it, and fail the build when the events stop matching it.
